translation_snapshot.source: A great helm that belonged to Garkul the Devourer, one of the greatest orcs ever to live.
translation_snapshot.target: 这是迄今为止最伟大的兽人，吞噬者加库尔的头盔。

translation_snapshot.source: After rescuing Melinda from Kryl-Feijan and the cultists you met her again in Last Hope.
translation_snapshot.target: 在你从克里尔·费扬邪教手中解救了梅琳达之后，你在最后的希望又碰到了她。

translation_snapshot.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed one invocation portal.
translation_snapshot.target: 在关闭1扇传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。

translation_snapshot.source: A thought-forged warrior wielding a massive battle-axe and clad in heavy armor.  It appears ready for battle.
translation_snapshot.target: 一位身穿重甲的精神体狂战士。他时刻准备着战斗。

translation_snapshot.source: Some are cursed with mental powers beyond their full control, turning them to a dark life powered by hatred.
translation_snapshot.target: 某些被诅咒者承受了超出他们控制的灵魂力量，终其一生都活在憎恨和黑暗中。
